newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP SAYS PAST 3 RESIGNATIONS UNRELATED.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP SAYS PAST 3 RESIGNATIONS UNRELATED.

text.p: Australia's largest listest company, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP), said on Friday the three resignations of executives over the past three days were unrelated.
"While the events have a regrettable coincidence they are really unrelated," BHP managing director John Prescott told a news conference.

Prescott was speaking at a news conference following the announcement earlier on Friday that BHP Petroleum chief John O'Connor had resigned because of irreconcilable differences between himself and the board.
O'Connor was reported in some newspapers this week as having promoted the float of the profitable petroleum division during briefings with analysts in Sydney and Melbourne.
O'Connor's resignation brings to three the number of senior executives who have resigned or retired in the last three days.
Minerals division chief Dick Carter resigned on Wednesday and iron ore boss Geoff Wedlock resigned on Thursday.
